Subject: Re: Private offer drawdown cadence + marketplace listing question

Hi Beth — great to hear Bluecrest wants to move forward. Outlined a suggested plan below and attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) draft.

Summary of proposed drawdown phases (for $150k commit):
- Phase 1 (activation + Q2 sprint): $60,000 allocated for onboarding, early POCs; target burn window: 2027-04-01 to 2027-06-30.
- Phase 2 (scale): $52,500 allocated to production usage; target: 2027-07-01 to 2027-09-30.
- Phase 3 (stabilize + runway): $37,500 for Q4 spike and buffer; target: 2027-10-01 to 2027-12-31.

Marketplace listing timing: once we accept the private offer and it is provisioned on GCP side, typical lead time to listing availability is 7-14 business days assuming artifacts/marketing assets are provided. If Bluecrest wants a co-sell enablement flag set on the listing we will start the co-sell intake with GCP at the time of activation — that adds ~3-5 business days for approvals.

Action items I need from Bluecrest to finalize the MAP and start the private-offer flow:
- Signed MAP (attached).
- PO or purchase details for the first draw (we can schedule the first draw for April 1st if procurement can issue before March 15th).
- Marketplace listing assets: logo, short/long description, and a 1-page one-pager for the listing.

Attached: Bluecrest_MAP_v1.pdf (draft MAP)

Happy to hop on a 30-min call Monday to walk through details.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, North America
Redwood Inference
